watches.name: Jumbo Self-Setting Wall Clock
watches.description: When the U.S. government needed a wall-mounted atomic clock for its offices—something large, legible, and always accurate—Marathon answered the call. Featuring a display that’s easily read from up to 30 feet away, the Jumbo Wall clock also provides a gold standard level of accuracy. The clock's self-setting and self-adjusting functions use radio frequencies broadcast from NIST's Colorado Atomic Clock and the DCF77 transmitter near Frankfurt, Germany. Over the years, thoughtful improvements have been made to the original design: A slimmer profile for easier wall mounting Option to display in six languages: English, French, Dutch, Italian, German, or Spanish More intuitive controls for simplified setup and adaptability for multiple time zones across the globe Temperature select in Celsius or Fahrenheit Date / Month or Month / Date display Dual antenna to support both North American and European radio signals—critical for U.S. operations overseas A split-display design that separates the time and other functions, reducing power usage without sacrificing visibility With its oversized digital readout and automatic synchronization with radio signals, the Jumbo Self-Setting Wall Clock remains a trusted timekeeping tool—in offices, classrooms, operations centres, hospitals, and homes across the globe. watches.name: Self-Setting Weather Station and Clock with 3 Remote Sensors
watches.description: Marathon’s Weather Station is a multi functional clock with an alarm and weather forecast data. The time is self-setting and self-adjusting using radio frequencies broadcast from NIST’s atomic clock. Easily choose between 4 time zones (PST, CST, MST, EST). The large display is highly legible, providing accurate information at a distance. It comes with 3 remote sensors that allow you to accurately monitor temperature and humidity in four locations in and around your house. Each remote sensor is equipped with a digital thermometer and hygrometer, as well as an independent display. You can easily view the temperature and humidity on the remote sensor without having to return to the main unit. In addition to the atomic time, temperature and humidity this weather station provides a reliable weather forecast for your specific location. The main unit has a memory function which stores the historical high and low information for both temperature and humidity. The main unit as well as the 3 remote sensors are all battery powered, which gives you the flexibility to place them in any location. This weather station is backed by a two-year warranty.
